description: Use when your user wants a shared room to work with a teammate and their AI (any vendor). Creates a private room owned by your user, seats you in it, and returns the invite link to share (plus a call-only link). The plain room URL works only for people already in the room, so never share it. Always offer your user the invite link from tell_your_user: the teammate joins with just a name and connects their own AI.

your_user_name.description: Your user's name as shown in the room (defaults to their account name)

name: create_room
title: Create a team room
